name: Rimetea
description: A Hungarian village under the limestone wall of Piatra Secuiului, every house whitewashed with green shutters and two windows facing the street. The sun comes up twice here, in a manner of speaking — it clears the ridge, drops behind it and comes back.
getting: About an hour from Cluj by car via Turda. The path up the mountain behind the village takes two hours and starts from the main square.
